name: Church Planting
overview: Church planting is grounded in Christ’s promise to build His church upon the foundation of faith, ensuring that the gates of hell will not overcome it. Jesus, having all authority in heaven and earth, commissions His followers to establish and shepherd local congregations, as overseers are called to care for the church purchased by His blood. The apostolic instruction to appoint elders in every city underscores the importance of order and leadership in new churches. Ultimately, church planting reflects the fulfillment of God’s plan to gather a diverse multitude from every nation to worship before His throne.
